To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) Fog Computing is a distributed platform that brings the cloud to the edge, (2) Fog Computing is an extension of the cloud, not an alternative, and (3) Fog Computing provides a distributed platform that enables the cloud to be extended to the edge.
the IoT is a disruptive phenomenon that will bring a new paradigm in Big Data and analytics, and that Fog Computing provides the right platform for IoT and Analytics.

Fog Computing is an architecture that extends the Cloud to the edge of the Internet, to the place where data is created by things, by people and by processes, for the following purposes: (i) to provide low latency, high bandwidth, high availability, and high security services to the IoT, and to the people and processes that use the IoT; (ii) to provide a platform for Big Data Analytics and Machine Learning; (iii) to enable the development and the deployment of new IoT applications,
In summary, our research is concerned with
how IoT and Fog Computing enable a distributed analytics platform for the Internet of Things.
the following questions: What is the impact of IoT on Big Data and Analytics?
the design, implementation and evaluation of Fog Computing as a platform for Internet of Things.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Fog Computing is a new distributed computing platform that brings the capabilities of the core data centers to the IoT endpoints, while retaining the benefits of edge processing.
the Fog Computing platform is the key to unlock the potential of IoT and Big Data and Analytics, and the key to the next generation of applications.
Fog Computing is the right architecture for the IoT era.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Fog Computing is a platform for IoT and Analytics.
Fog Computing is a platform that provides the right environment to support IoT and Analytics.
the IoT is a new platform for Big Data and Analytics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the edge is a new frontier in computing and data analytics.
Fog Computing is a new platform for Big Data and Analytics that is required for the success of IoT and its associated business models.
IoT and Analytics are inextricably linked.
